units.source_text: 甚至企图让狗唱人工之歌啊。

en.t: You even try to make the dog sing an artificial song.

units.source_text: 看来它准会变成神秘的动物。

en.t: At this rate it will surely turn into some mysterious animal.

units.source_text: 莫非太太寂寞了就剪狗毛？”

en.t: Could it be that whenever madam feels lonely, she cuts the dog's hair?"

units.source_text: 丈夫脱下外衣，信手一扔，又解下裤子的吊带，

en.t: The husband took off his coat, tossed it aside without a thought, and then unfastened his trouser suspenders,

units.source_text: 一边用一只脚脱下单条裤腿，一边随意挠着乱蓬蓬的头发。

en.t: while pulling one trouser leg off with one foot and casually scratching his tousled hair.
